methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Logistic activities long adopted energy efficiency and ship energy efficiency management plan in its activities

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Practitioner conference paper describing Total Abu Al Bukhoosh (TABK) marine and aviation logistics energy-efficiency initiatives and ISO 50001 certification. Energy performance is addressed through operational practices (slow steaming, virtual arrival, anchoring of dynamically positioned vessels) and through regulatory indices (EEDI/SEEMP) and KPI monitoring cited only as context. No EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or characterised (no identifiable variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach) — incidental mention only.

paper_type.evidence_quote: We have been striving for efficiency and excellence in our overall marine operations activities

stage1.notes: TABK marine logistics energy-efficiency practitioner paper; EEDI/KPIs cited as regulatory/monitoring context only, no EnPI/EnB model characterised. EEDI mention flagged for human review.
